summary: Tested real-time presence system for Kora OS ERP. All backend APIs (16/17 tests passed, 1 skipped) and frontend components verified working. Features: sidebar PresenceAvatarStack with online users, mini Figma-style avatars on posts being edited, EntityPresenceBar in post dialog, polling every 30s.

issues: Missing DialogDescription for ARIA accessibility (console warning only, no functional impact)

success_rate.backend: 94% (16/17 tests passed, 1 skipped due to second test user unavailable)

seed_data_creation: Created test presence record with user_id='test_user_presence_123' to simulate multi-user presence (cleaned up after test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Presence system fully implemented and tested. Backend uses 'presence' MongoDB collection with 60-second online threshold. Key features: 1) POST /api/presence/heartbeat creates/updates presence with page/entity info, 2) GET /api/presence/online returns other online users (excludes current), 3) GET /api/presence/entity/{type}/{id} returns entity viewers (excludes current), 4) POST /api/presence/leave clears entity presence. Frontend: PresenceAvatarStack in sidebar (Layout.js:180-187) shows when onlineUsers.length > 0, mini avatars in queue table (SocialMediaPage.js:1947-1952) show editors of each post, EntityPresenceBar in post dialog (SocialMediaPage.js:2720-2722) shows when editing and entityViewers.length > 0. Tooltip shows user name + current page or 'Editando: {entity_title}' in Spanish.

frontend_sidebar_presence.verification: Visible in sidebar with simulated second user, shows avatar + green online dot + '1 online' label, tooltip shows user name and current activity

frontend_queue_presence.verification: Mini avatars appear next to post titles when another user is viewing/editing that post

frontend_entity_presence_bar.verification: Component renders when editingPost && entityViewers.length > 0, shows blue bar with avatars and 'X está viendo esto' text

frontend_use_presence_hook.verification: Sends heartbeat on mount and every 30s, fetches online users and entity viewers, provides leaveEntity function

api_verification.POST /api/presence/heartbeat: 200 OK - Creates/updates presence record with user info, page, entity context
api_verification.GET /api/presence/online: 200 OK - Returns {online_users: [], total: N} excluding current user
api_verification.GET /api/presence/entity/{type}/{id}: 200 OK - Returns {viewers: [], count: N} excluding current user
api_verification.POST /api/presence/leave: 200 OK - Returns {ok: true}, clears entity fields
